days.unitSubtitle: Week 1 · seeing what's already here

days.unitSubtitle: Week 1 · seeing what's already here

days.unitSubtitle: Week 1 · seeing what's already here

days.unitSubtitle: Week 2 · the pattern underneath

days.unitSubtitle: Week 2 · the pattern underneath

morning.title: Before the asks arrive

days.unitSubtitle: Week 2 · the pattern underneath

left.sub: You can still name it to yourself

days.unitSubtitle: Week 2 · the pattern underneath

morning.title: The last authored morning

steps.prompt: Thirty days. Arriving this morning, you feel…

options.label: Ready to live it without a map

steps.prompt: The one loop you will keep living.
Today we don't add a new lesson. We choose how you'll come back.

exercise.title: How You Will Return
exercise.purpose: The path does not end. The authored map does.

steps.prompt: You will miss days. The return move is…

options.label: Just open the app and leave

steps.prompt: Attach the return to something that already exists.

options.label: After I sit on the bed
When I notice I've been gone

steps.prompt: One slow breath. This is still the place.
steps.body: Not a finished self. The one who showed up for thirty ordinary days — and will show up unevenly after.

exercise.intro: Coming back is the whole practice. The map was only to teach you the way.

evening.title: The journey continues
evening.purpose: What did I notice across 30 days?

steps.prompt: Closing this authored path, you feel…
If you told day-1 you one thing…
Optional: a last honest line, only for you.
